appearance.themeHelper: Choose between light and dark mode, or follow your system settings
appearance.startupHelper: Choose which page appears when the app launches
appearance.usingCustom: You're using a custom accent. Click "Use System" to go back to your system color.
appearance.dateTimeDescription: DexReader uses your system's date and time format settings. Dates are displayed in chapter lists, reading history, and error logs.
appearance.configureDateButton: Configure Date Format in System Settings
appearance.configureDateHelper: This will open your operating system's regional settings where you can customize date and time formats.
appearance.configureDateFallback:
Unable to open system settings automatically. Please open your system date/time settings manually:

Windows: Settings → Time & Language → Region
macOS: System Preferences → Language & Region
Linux: Check your desktop environment settings
appearance.languageHelper: Choose the language for DexReader's interface. Changing this will affect menus, buttons, and all UI text. A restart will be required to apply the new language.
appearance.syncContentLanguage: Sync content language with display language
appearance.syncContentLanguageDescription: Automatically show manga chapters in your display language when available
appearance.contentLanguagesDescription: Select up to 5 languages in priority order. Chapters will be filtered based on this preference.
appearance.contentLanguageFallbackInfo: If your preferred language isn't available, chapters will fallback to English, then any available language.

language.languageSectionDescription: Configure DexReader display language, and content language preferences for filtering manga chapters.
language.contentLanguageDescription: Control which languages of manga content you see when browsing and searching. This filters manga by their available translations.

downloads.locationDescription: Where should we save your downloaded chapters?
downloads.locationTip: Tip: Choose a location with plenty of free space for your manga collection.
downloads.confirmationDescription: When should we ask before downloading chapters?

batchOnly.label: Batch Only
batchOnly.description: Only ask when downloading multiple chapters at once

downloads.concurrentDescription: How many chapters should download at the same time?
downloads.concurrentHelper: Higher values download faster but use more bandwidth and resources

forceDarkMode.label: Force dark mode in reader
forceDarkMode.description: Always use dark background when reading, regardless of app theme

highQuality.description: Full resolution images, uses more bandwidth

reader.globalSettingsDescription: These settings apply to all manga by default. You can override them per-manga in the reader.
reader.readingModeHelper: How pages are displayed when reading manga
reader.skipCoverPages: Skip cover pages (show first page alone)
reader.overridesDescription: Manga with custom reading mode settings. Reset them to use global defaults.
reader.emptyOverrides: No custom settings yet. Change reading modes in the reader to create per-manga overrides!

performance.description: Configure how much memory DexReader can use for caching manga chapters. Higher tiers load more chapters in advance.
performance.systemInfo: System RAM: {{ram}} GB | Recommended: {{recommended}} MB (10%) | Maximum: {{max}} MB (30%)

low.label: Low ({{size}} MB)
low.description: 1-2 chapters cached | Best for low-end systems

customCacheError.tooLow: Cache size must be at least 10 MB
customCacheError.tooHigh: Cache size cannot exceed {{max}} MB (30% of system RAM)

customCacheWarning.low: Low cache may cause frequent reloads. We recommend at least 30 MB
customCacheWarning.high: This exceeds our recommendation of {{recommended}} MB (10% of system RAM). Higher values might slow things down.

cacheManagement.sectionDescription: Manage temporary data to balance performance and storage usage.
cacheManagement.coverCacheDescription: Manage temporary cover image storage to improve browsing performance.

coverCacheLimitHelper.unlimited: Cache all covers without limits. Older covers are automatically removed when needed.
coverCacheLimitHelper.limited: Older covers are automatically removed when the limit is reached.

cacheManagement.metadataCacheDescription: Manage cached manga information for offline access.
cacheManagement.autoManageNote: DexReader automatically manages this cache by removing non-library manga that haven't been accessed in 90 days.

advanced.updatesDescription: Configure how DexReader checks for and installs updates

autoCheck.label: Automatically check for updates
autoCheck.description: Check for new versions when the app starts

autoDownload.label: Automatically download updates
autoDownload.description: Download updates in the background. You choose when to install.

logging.sectionDescription: DexReader maintains log files to help diagnose issues and track application behavior. You can configure how long logs are retained and manage existing log files from this section.
logging.deletedOldLogs: Cleaned up logs older than {{days}} days

openFile.title: Open Settings File
openFile.description: Edit settings.json directly in your default editor

reset.title: Reset to Default
reset.description: Restore all settings to their default values

confirm.title: Reset Settings to Default?
confirm.message:
This will restore all settings to their default values.

Your library and reading progress will NOT be affected.

clearAll.title: Clear Data & Reset App
clearAll.description: Delete all data (library, progress, settings) and restart

confirm.title: Clear All Data?
confirm.message:
This action cannot be undone.

All of the following will be permanently deleted:
• Library and collections
• Reading progress and history
• All settings and preferences

The app will restart after clearing data.
